about: ECHOES OF THE VOID environment assets (Tab env helper). Blender Z-up, exported glTF +Y up. Blender -Y = model front = Godot +Z. Origins at base centre on the ground (z=0) unless the notes say otherwise. Dimensions in metres as [x, y(depth), z(height)] in Blender axes. UVs: world-scale box projection, 1 UV unit = 1 m (set uv1_scale to taste, e.g. 0.5 for a 2 m tile); Screen faces are 0..1 planar. Material slots are named by role (Panel, PanelAlt, Trim, Floor, Dark, Metal, Accent, Hazard, Rubber, Grate, Glass*, Screen, Emit*): override by name to theme an area. Constant PBR defaults are set so every file looks right untextured; Hazard carries an embedded 512 px stripe texture. Child node pivots are listed in Blender coordinates (Godot: x, z, -y).

alien_plant_a.notes: Bioluminescent stalk plant ~1.2 m wide, up to 2 m tall: dark curved stalks ending in glowing EmitPlant bulbs (teal). Origin ground centre. Sway via a vertex shader or a small node rotation.

alien_plant_b.notes: Fan-frond plant ~3 m across, ~1 m tall: 9 dark double-sided fronds with glowing EmitPlant mid-veins and glowing seed pods at the centre. Origin ground centre.

alien_plant_c.notes: Cap-fungus cluster up to ~3.5 m tall (one big cap + 4 smaller): dark caps with glowing EmitPlant gills underneath and glowing spots on top. Origin ground centre.

alien_rock_a.notes: Boulder ~4 x 3 x 2.5 m with layered strata + a small companion stone. Material Rock (use rock_alien textures, uv1_scale ~0.35). Origin ground centre.

alien_rock_b.notes: Large layered rock mound ~9 x 6 x 4.5 m with two satellite stones. Origin ground centre.

alien_rock_c.notes: Tall rock spire / hoodoo ~11 m tall, strongly layered. Origin ground centre.

alien_rock_d.notes: Long flat layered outcrop / ridge ~13 x 6 x 3 m (cover and terrain breakup). Origin ground centre.

ammo_pistol.notes: Energy Pistol ammo pickup: two CYAN cells in a clip, 0.13 x 0.06 x 0.15 m, origin base centre. EmitCellPistol = cyan.

ammo_rifle.notes: Pulse Rifle ammo pickup: one ORANGE box cell, 0.12 x 0.08 x 0.23 m, origin base centre. EmitCellRifle = orange.

antenna_mast.notes: Lattice comms mast 19 m tall (triangular truss), antenna array + equipment boxes at the top, two EmitRed aviation beacons, three guy wires anchored 7 m out. Origin ground centre.

barrel.notes: Chemical/fuel drum 0.6 m diameter x 0.91 m, Accent body (recolour per area), Hazard band. Origin base centre.

cable_bundle.notes: Bundle of 7 floor cables snaking along X for 4 m (x -2..2, ~0.6 m wide), with two hazard cable ramps. Origin floor centre. No collision needed.

cargo_containers.notes: Stack of three 20 ft shipping containers (6.06 x 2.44 x 2.59 m each): two side by side (orange Accent, blue ContainerBlue) and one on top (PanelAlt), corrugated sides, corner posts, end doors on +X. ~6.3 x 5.3 x 5.2 m, origin ground centre.

cargo_lift.notes: Cargo lift: 7 x 7 x 8.4 m frame (4 columns with guide rails, top beams, pulley housing), origin base centre at the lower floor level. Child "Platform" (6 x 6 m deck, top surface at its pivot, railings on +X/-X/+Y, open at -Y, control pedestal with EmitStatus button + Screen): move it along the up axis (0 -> 7.6 m max). EmitAmber beacon on the frame.

ceiling_lamp.notes: Hanging strip light 1.2 x 0.24 m, origin at the TOP of its 0.6 m hanging wires (attach to the ceiling), the lamp body hangs 0.6..0.76 m below. EmitLight diffuser faces down.

chair.notes: Swivel office chair 0.64 x 0.64 x 1.15 m, origin base centre, seat faces -Y. Knock over / rotate freely.

comms_console.notes: Comms station 3.5 x 0.85 x 2.6 m (desk + radio rack on the left), origin base centre, operator stands at -Y. Three Screen monitors + 4 small rack screens; EmitRed = transmit button; EmitAmber/EmitGreen rack LEDs.

conduit_console.notes: Wall-standing puzzle console 3.6 x 0.55 x 3.05 m, origin base centre, back against the wall at y=0, front -Y. "Screen" = the empty 2.6 x 1.34 m display (planar 0..1 UVs, z 1.08..2.42, at Blender y=-0.305) for the conduit grid; a second small Screen on the ledge. EmitCyan rings on the side power columns, EmitLight bar on top.

console_large.notes: Large control desk 3.1 x 0.95 x 2.0 m with four Screens (three angled main + one top status), button field (EmitGreen/Amber/Cyan). Origin base centre, operators at -Y.

containment_tube.notes: Specimen containment tube 1.9 m diameter base, 3.95 m tall (glass 0.4..3.0 m), filled with Liquid (semi-transparent teal, slight emission) and a crystal-laced specimen (Tissue + EmitCrystal). Origin base centre. Screen on the base front.

containment_tube_broken.notes: Shattered containment tube (same footprint as containment_tube): jagged GlassBroken remains, glass shards on the floor out to 2.4 m, black/violet crystal residue (Crystal + EmitCrystal) and a dark dried Tissue puddle. Origin base centre.

crate_large.notes: Large cargo container/crate 1.62 x 1.12 x 1.21 m, safety-orange Accent body with gunmetal ribs, fork pockets, a blank label plate. Origin base centre.

crate_small.notes: Small cargo crate 0.62 m cube, reinforced edges, hazard tag, handle. Origin base centre. Stackable.

cryo_pod.notes: Upright stasis pod, 1.4 m plinth, 2.66 m tall, origin base centre, front -Y. Child "Lid" (frame + GlassFrost canopy) is hinged at its pivot on the right-front edge: rotate the Lid about the up axis to swing it open (Blender Z -100 deg = Godot rotation.y -100 deg; it clears the shell). EmitPod = cyan status lights (plinth ring, side strips, lid band). Screen surfaces on the plinth and the back service box.

crystal_cluster_a.notes: Large Echo crystal cluster ~4 m tall on a dark rock base: black-violet glassy Crystal prisms with glowing EmitCrystal bands + small glowing shards. Origin ground centre. Add an OmniLight3D (violet, ~3 m) inside for the glow.

crystal_cluster_b.notes: Medium Echo crystal cluster ~2.2 m tall. Origin ground centre.

crystal_cluster_c.notes: Small Echo crystal cluster ~1 m tall (good for walls/corridors infested by the Echo, also indoors). Origin ground centre.

datapad.notes: Research-log datapad 0.24 x 0.17 x 0.017 m lying flat, origin base centre, screen faces up (EmitData, planar 0..1 UVs: swap in a log-screen texture if wanted).

debris_pile.notes: Rubble pile ~2.2 x 2.2 x 0.8 m (concrete chunks, broken panels, bent struts, a cable). Origin floor centre.

desk.notes: Office desk 1.6 x 0.76 x 0.76 m, drawers on the left, modesty panel at +Y. Origin base centre, user at -Y.

door_panel.notes: Wall door control 0.2 x 0.3 m, origin = centre of its back face (mount at ~1.3 m), front -Y. Big round EmitStatus button (default red; tint green/amber), small Screen above.

fallen_beam.notes: Collapsed ceiling I-beam across a 4 m corridor (along X), 4.6 x 1.2 x 4.0 m, origin floor centre. Beam underside rises from 1.43 m (x=-1.5) to 1.63 m (x=+1.5) at y=0: a standing 1.8 m player must crouch; crouch passage is between the debris piles (x -1.4..1.5). Put a crouch-only blocker under the beam. Hanging cables reach down to ~2.7 m. EmitLight = broken light tube on the floor (flicker it).

generator.notes: Aux power generator 2.6 x 1.7 x 2.7 m, origin base centre, front -Y (control panel, gauge, lever, louvred doors), fan on +X side. Children: "Fan" (spin about its local X axis), "Needle" (gauge needle, rotate about Blender Y / Godot Z, 0 = 12 o'clock), "Lever" (rotate about X, ~-60 deg = pulled). EmitLamp = big warning lamp on top; EmitRed/EmitAmber/EmitGreen = status buttons; Screen on the panel. The decal reads AUX GENERATOR; textures/label_generator_{coolant,regulator,main}.png are drop-in replacements for material Decal_Generator.

habitat_module.notes: Exterior station module: 14 m long, 6 m diameter pressurised habitat on legs (warm EmitLamp window strip on -X), gold Insulation radiator panels on top, and a 5.2 x 4.6 x 4.6 m airlock building at the -Y end with a door (EmitDoor light above, hazard band, EmitAmber beacon). ~6 x 24 x 12 m, origin ground centre. Sells "the facility exists outside".

keycard.notes: Security keycard at real size 0.086 x 0.054 x 0.0036 m lying flat, origin base centre (scale x2-3 for a readable pickup). EmitAmber chip.

keypad_panel.notes: Wall keypad 0.28 x 0.42 m. Origin = centre of its BACK face (mount it on the wall surface at ~1.3 m height); front -Y. 12 keys with a digit decal (1-9, C, 0, E). Screen = code display; EmitStatus = status bar (default red, tint green when unlocked).

kit_catwalk.notes: Catwalk section 2.12 m wide x 4 m long (along Blender Y = Godot Z), walkable grated deck top at z=0, railings 1.1 m on both sides, a cable tray hanging under it to z=-0.45. Chain sections end to end every 4 m.

kit_ceiling.notes: 4x4 m ceiling tile, underside of the beams at z=4.0 (place at the same origin as the floor). Two recessed light strips (EmitLight) and a vent grille. Faces down.

kit_corner.notes: Corner trim column 0.36 x 0.36 x 4 m, origin bottom centre: put it on the grid corner where two walls meet (works for inner and outer corners; covers the wall end ribs). EmitLight strips on all 4 faces.

kit_door_frame.notes: 4 m wall section with a 2.4 m wide x 3.0 m tall opening centred on x=0, frame protrudes 0.24 m on both faces. Leaves (kit_door_leaf) sit in the y=0 plane: closed positions x=-0.6 (rotated 180 deg about up) and x=+0.6; open = slide 1.25 m outward into the wall. EmitDoor header bars on both faces (tint red/amber/green for lock state).

kit_door_leaf.notes: One sliding leaf 1.25 x 3.0 x 0.08 m, origin bottom centre, meeting edge (hazard band + rubber seal) at local +X. Both faces detailed. For the left leaf rotate 180 deg about up.

kit_floor.notes: 4x4 m floor, top at z=0 (x,y -2..2), 0.25 thick. Four 2 m plates with seams and bolts. UVs: 1 UV unit = 1 m (world-scale box projection) on every kit piece.

kit_floor_grate.notes: 4x4 m grated floor (real bar geometry, walkable top at z=0) over a 0.9 m deep pit with pipes. Material Grate can take grate_* textures or stay constant.

kit_pillar.notes: Free-standing octagonal column, 0.8 m wide at the base, 4 m tall, origin bottom centre. Four vertical EmitLight strips.

kit_vent_cover.notes: Knock-off vent grille for kit_wall_vent, 1.08 x 0.03 x 0.78 m. Its node origin is at the cover centre (Blender 0,-0.115,0.55), but placed at the same transform as the wall it fits (the node offset is baked into the node translation) - use a RigidBody3D and an impulse toward -Y Blender (= Godot +Z) when the Stalker bursts out.

kit_wall.notes: 4 m wall. x -2..2, z 0..4, thickness 0.3 (y -0.15..0.15 Blender). Detailed side faces Blender -Y (= Godot +Z). Back side is a plain Panel face. Edge ribs are half-width so neighbours make a full rib.

kit_wall_damaged.notes: Damaged 4 m wall (kit_wall variant). Same footprint and edge silhouette as kit_wall: x -2..2, z 0..4, body y -0.15..0.15 (Blender), half-width edge ribs and the same cornice at x=+-2, plain Panel back, so it tiles next to kit_wall. A jagged tear (about 1.7 x 2.2 m, centred x 0.4, z 1.95) with the face plates peeled outward toward the room (-Y Blender = +Z Godot) up to 0.45 m; behind it exposed I-beam ribs (one buckled), quilted Dark insulation, a snapped Accent conduit and hanging cables. A violet crystal cluster (12 faceted shards, 0.2-0.9 m, slot EmitCrystal) bursts out of the tear. Upper-right plate hangs loose. Cornice light strip is broken: only the left 1.45 m is EmitLight (flicker it in code if wanted), the rest is dead (Dark) with one fallen tube. Damage stays in front of the wall plane, within y -0.6..0.15, so a collision box for kit_wall still fits; the bent plates and crystals stick out up to 0.6 m into the room. Same slot names as kit_wall plus EmitCrystal; UVs 1 unit = 1 m.

kit_wall_pipes.notes: 4 m wall with four horizontal pipes (z 1.6..2.6) on brackets, a valve wheel, a gauge and a vertical cable bundle. Pipes end flush at x=+-2 so neighbouring kit_wall_pipes continue the run.

kit_wall_screen.notes: 4 m wall with a 2.24 x 1.21 m wall display: material "Screen" (planar 0..1 UVs, z 1.52..2.73) - put a ViewportTexture or emissive UI texture on it.

kit_wall_vent.notes: 4 m wall with a 1.1 x 0.8 m floor-level vent opening (x -0.55..0.55, z 0.15..0.95) and a 1.35 m dark duct behind it (extends into +Y Blender = Godot -Z behind the wall). Put kit_vent_cover in the opening: its origin matches this wall origin.

kit_wall_window.notes: 4 m wall with a 3.0 x 1.6 m observation window (z 1.0..2.6), double Glass panes and a centre mullion, deep sill with an EmitLight under-strip. Same footprint as kit_wall.

lab_equipment.notes: Lab equipment cluster on a cabinet: microscope, centrifuge (glass lid) and an analyser with two Screens. 1.24 x 0.8 x 1.2 m, origin base centre, front -Y.

lab_table.notes: Lab bench 1.8 x 0.84 x 1.25 m, work surface at 0.92 m, drawers on the left, backsplash on +Y. Origin base centre, front -Y.

lab_table_clutter.notes: lab_table with clutter: beakers (Glass + Liquid), a flask, a tipped beaker with a spill, a sample rack, papers and a glowing Echo crystal sample in a dish (EmitCrystal).

landing_pad.notes: Circular landing pad 32 m diameter, deck top at z=0.4 m, Marking (yellow) / MarkingWhite paint, 24 amber EmitPad edge lights, access steps on +-X, a fuel umbilical tower at +Y with an EmitRed beacon. Origin ground centre. Place the shuttle at the centre on the deck (z=0.4).

locker.notes: Security locker 0.62 x 0.56 x 1.95 m, origin base centre, front -Y. Child "Door" hinged on its left edge (pivot x=-0.295): rotate about up axis by about +100 deg (Blender Z+ = Godot rotation.y +) to open. Put the Energy Pistol inside at z~1.0. EmitStatus lock light (red -> green).

med_bed.notes: Medical bed 1.1 x 2.1 x 1.95 m (with the vitals monitor), origin base centre, head end +Y. Screen = vitals monitor; EmitCyan base strip.

med_cabinet.notes: Medical supply cabinet 1.0 x 0.5 x 1.9 m, glass-front upper shelves with supplies, closed lower doors with a green cross. Origin base centre, front -Y; back against a wall.

medkit.notes: Medkit pickup 0.37 x 0.23 x 0.16 m, origin base centre. EmitCross = green cross on top and front (pulse it). Slow spin/bob looks good.

monitor.notes: Desk monitor 0.58 x 0.2 x 0.57 m on a stand, Screen 0.55 x 0.32 m facing -Y. Origin base centre.

pipe_bend.notes: 90 deg pipe elbow, 0.3 m diameter, bend radius 1 m: enters along +X at (-1.5,0,0) and leaves along +Z at (0,0,1.5) (Blender). Flanged ends match pipe_straight. Origin = bend centre axis point (0,0,0).

pipe_straight.notes: Industrial pipe 4 m long along X (x -2..2), 0.3 m diameter, flanges at both ends and the middle. Origin at the pipe CENTRE (axis), not the base.

reactor_core.notes: Reactor column, 6.0 m diameter base, ~18 m to the top of the exhaust pipes (16 m cap), origin base centre. Children: "Core" (the EmitCore orange column inside a Glass sleeve: pulse its emission / scale), "Ring1" (z 6.5 m) and "Ring2" (z 10.5 m): rotate each about the up axis (opposite directions look good). Walkable base rim at 0.9-1.25 m; place catwalks around it at ring height.

satellite_dish.notes: Comms dish station: concrete pad + equipment building (EmitLight over the door), 10 m parabolic dish tilted 35 deg above the horizon toward -Y with a feed horn and EmitRed beacon, a few Echo crystals growing on the dish face. ~10.5 x 9 x 11 m, origin ground centre. Child "Dish" (the whole rotating head, pivot on the tower axis at z=4.4): rotate about up for azimuth.

security_gate.notes: Blast door assembly 6.0 x 1.0 x 5.0 m (frame depth 1.0), clear opening 4.4 x 3.8 m, origin base centre. Children "LeafL" (pivot at x=-1.225) and "LeafR" (pivot x=+1.225), each 2.15 m wide + 0.15 m interlocking teeth, 3.85 m tall, 0.4 m thick (0.52 with ribs). Open = slide LeafL by -2.3 m and LeafR by +2.3 m along X (they slide behind the frame). Hazard fields on both faces, EmitRed beacons on the frame (pulse while moving).

server_rack.notes: Server rack 0.66 x 1.02 x 2.12 m, front -Y covered in blade units with tiny status LEDs (EmitGreen/Amber/Cyan; animate by swapping emission energy), cables out the back. Origin base centre.

shuttle.notes: OSV-2 PERSEPHONE dropship (helper f77ac026, v2). Nose at Godot -Z, ramp at +Z, origin on the ground under the centre. Two main engines in nacelles (EmitEngine), tripod gear (collision boxes in props.gd CUSTOM). 3 embedded texture sets (2048 albedo/normal + 1024 ORM).

terminal.notes: Standing desk terminal 0.7 x 0.62 x 1.5 m: pedestal, sloped keyboard deck, tilted Screen (planar 0..1, 0.56 x 0.36 m). Origin base centre, operator at -Y.

the_spire.notes: The Spire: black faceted alien monolith ~61 m tall (base ~20 m across, plus base shards to ~27 m), twisted 7-sided form, faint violet EmitVein lines on alternating edges, a few floating fragments near the top (z 40..60). Origin ground centre (base sinks 2 m below z=0). Seen from far away: low poly by design.

turret_broken.notes: Destroyed floor sentry turret 1.0 x 1.1 x 1.2 m: base, column, head knocked sideways with twin barrels drooping, a dim EmitRed sensor, torn cables. Origin base centre.

wall_lamp.notes: Wall work-lamp 0.36 x 0.16 x 0.2 m, origin = back centre (mount on a wall), angled down/forward; EmitLamp lens. Pair with an OmniLight3D/SpotLight3D at the lens (Blender 0,-0.12,-0.06).
